Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Moultrie City Manager Discusses Origins of CNS Network in Georgia for Community Broadband Bits Episode 39 By Christopher Mitchell on Mar 26, 2013 Mike Scott, City Manager of Moultrie in Georgia, joins us for Episode #39 of the Community Broadband Bits podcast to share the origins of the Community Network Services (CNS) network that joins four towns in four counties in rural southwest Georgia. In this interview, Mike Scott shares some of the benefits of the network for local schools and community savings. Built originally because the existing cable and telephone companies would not invest in their communities, CNS has proved itself an incredibly valuable community investment. CNS is credited with creating over 6,000 jobs in the communities it serves, a tremendous boon for the communities that joined together to create this network.
